scope: Corollary 3.56 (Finite positive parts of detected scalings) of the manuscript “Log abundance for compact Kähler spaces under logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity” (preprints/Log-abundance-for-compact-Kahler-spaces-under-logarithmic-Iitaka-subadditivity-October-6-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 46adc5be1070213b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 79. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let a gklt adjoint with globally nef carrier data be run with scaling of the trace of a Kähler class on a fixed smooth carrier. Suppose that every chosen negative analytic ray has an actual global rational line detector and that the total boundary trace on each positive scaling segment is globally modified big. Every segment whose scaling parameters lie in a fixed interval [ε, T], with ε > 0, is finite. If the driving adjoint is not pseudo-effective, the scaling terminates with a Mori fibre space.
